description:

I gave my AI agents a company with Paperclip. Paperclip is an open-source app for managing a team of AI agents, with shared goals, assigned tasks, budgets, and human oversight. Their first job: figure out why flushing the studio toilet keeps disconnecting everyone from the NAS. I hired a Claude Code CEO, brought in my existing Hermes agents, and added Codex and agents running local models to build an IT department that can actually work together. Then I handed them the ticket and watched them investigate my real network, question each other's work, and come back with a verdict I still want to blame on the toilet.

In this video you'll learn how to install Paperclip, connect remote Hermes agents, build a team across different AI harnesses, automate checks with routines, and use approval gates and watchdog agents to review decisions and check whether stopped tasks are genuinely finished or blocked.
